design_deviations: Spec §4.x originally called for HeroTileMorph mounted as firstSlot of the first rail (single-widget hero+tile-0). Implementation kept hero as the existing Positioned(top:0, height:expandedH) overlay and replaced only the inner AnimatedCrossFade with HeroTileMorph. Reason: full-bleed backdrop (1920x1080) cannot live inside a tile-sized container without clipping; tile-0 mount also creates row-loading coupling. FirstSlotConfig + CinemaRow.firstSlot API remain as optional future plumbing if a later spec re-decides.
boundary_invariants: Single-source widget contract: HeroTileMorph drives a single AnimationController; no parallel hero subtrees in any morph frame.
Closed specs (home-cinematic-redesign, home-grid-optimization, home-grid-visual-polish, player-cinematic-redesign) NOT opened. All changes are new widget + point-of-use integration only.
Upstream contract from home-grid-stability-pass (cardHeightDp, pinnedSlotIdx, focusedScale, Pinned-Slot Invariant, metadataReservedHeightDp) read-only.
Legacy /home (HomeScreen) not touched — morph applied only in /home-cinematic.

TV-perf rules from flutter-tv-perf.md respected: no BackdropFilter, ShaderMask, AnimatedContainer.width, BoxShadow.blurRadius>12, ImageFilter.blur. Used: AnimatedBuilder, Opacity, SizedBox, ClipRRect.
Animation fixed: 300ms duration, Curves.easeInOutCubic, no spring physics.
Focus survives morph via persistent FocusNode (_heroWatchFocusNode owned by CinematicHomeScreen, passed to HeroTileMorph) — no frame drops focus.
MediaQuery.disableAnimations honoured: instant snap to target state via disableAnimations* commands.
Carousel timer, preview player lifecycle, baseUrl boot prompt — preserved (no changes to those code paths).
